finalText: Migration's done — 12 stragglers moved from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })` across billing, accounts, support, orders, analytics, and catalog. Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` and the `cache.query` calls alone, since those aren't the same thing. The verifier confirms it: `OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved`.
